assessment.receiver: At least some events reached the specified UET receiver.94 is an event count in a retention-limited view, not94 distinct or Microsoft-attributed orders. Parameter labels do not verify values, currency conversion, order joins or deduplication.
assessment.one_primary_goal: Prefer the existing same-tag custom purchase action goal, if fresh fields confirm it. Exclude overlapping URL/event proxies from Include in Conversions while preserving Active/All reporting. This removes overlapping bidding/reporting goals, not duplicated transport or orders.
assessment.counting: Keep sales All unless an independent business reason requires otherwise. Unique is per click and is not an order-dedup repair.
assessment.revenue: Preserve dynamic amount/currency and a documented merchandise-subtotal definition; do not replace with a fixed price. Review any existing fallback independently. A supported zero fallback can avoid fictitious positive revenue when data is absent, but does not repair missing values and is not included in an unreviewed change.
assessment.consent: Healthy is valid-signal coverage, not grant rate, universal compliance or all-event correctness. Missing indicates0% valid signal coverage in the last7days for that event type; classify current request/initiator and actual consent state before changing a stream. Preserve Shopify requirements and Basic gating. No blanket consent-granted patch, extra UET or guessed proprietary query parameter.
assessment.dedup: Goal overlap, duplicate browser transport and browser/server event dedup are separate. CAPI requires stable shared event identity; adding it is not the smallest supported correction here.
